extra.message: User input req.query.q is truncated but concatenated directly into the SQL string passed to models.sequelize.query(). No parameterization or escaping is applied, so an attacker can inject SQL (e.g. UNION-based) and read arbitrary data such as user credentials.

extra.message: req.body.email is interpolated directly into the SQL query string, allowing SQL injection. An attacker can supply an email such as ' OR 1=1-- to bypass authentication and log in as any user, including the administrator.

extra.message: req.body.id is passed directly as the MongoDB/MarsDB query selector ({ _id: req.body.id }). An attacker can send an object query operator (e.g. {"$ne":null}) to update multiple reviews they do not own, combined with the multi:true option.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: req.params.id is concatenated into a MongoDB $where JavaScript predicate ('this.product == ' + id). An attacker can inject arbitrary JavaScript into $where, enabling data exfiltration and denial of service (the global sleep function is also exposed for this purpose).

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: req.params.id is interpolated into a MongoDB $where expression (this.orderId === '${id}'). An attacker can inject JavaScript/NoSQL logic to retrieve other users' orders or execute arbitrary server-side JavaScript.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: req.params.id is parsed with JSON.parse and used directly as a Sequelize where clause ({ id: JSON.parse(req.params.id) }). Supplying a JSON object containing query operators (e.g. {"$gt":0}) lets an attacker manipulate the query logic and enumerate recycle records.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: Uploaded XML is parsed with libxml.parseXml(data, { noent: true, ... }). Enabling noent resolves external entities, so a crafted XML document can read local files (e.g. /etc/passwd) or trigger denial of service via entity expansion.

extra.message: The target from query.to is passed to res.redirect(). cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
